kim: ran a short nsys + nvprof sweep comparing our baseline microbatch steering vs a 'wavefront-aligned' scheduling tweak. quick notes below.
sasha: nice — what is wavefront-aligned in this context?
kim: we force microbatch starts across pipeline/tensor ranks to align within a small phase window so allreduce start times overlap more, reducing idle tails. simple heuristic: shift microbatch dispatch by up to +/- 1 step to minimize cross-rank skew.
robert: interesting. does that interact with KV cache warmup? iirc kv cache fill happens per-token and can shift effective start times.
kim: yes — that's the weird part. when KV warmup hits on rank0 earlier, its compute finishes earlier and then waits on allreduce. alignment helps but kernel selection sometimes moves the compute boundary.
maya: can you paste the nsight timeline or the nvprof snapshot numbers?
kim: putting the short output here. nvprof aggregated (per-step):
```
baseline: allreduce tail avg 7.8ms, compute overlap 62%, throughput 110 tok/s
wavefront-aligned: allreduce tail avg 2.4ms, compute overlap 78%, throughput 118 tok/s
notes: p99 latency reduced ~17%, p95 similar, small increase in steady throughput
```
sasha: nice delta on tail. did you capture kernel names? could be kernel-switching due to sequence length or quantization path.
kim: yes — captured kernel list. we see frequent kernel selection flips for gelu/qkv kernels on sequences > 512 which desyncs the wavefront. snippet: 
```
rank0 kernels: lm_forward_fp16_kerA -> fused_softmax_ker1 -> allreduce
rank1 kernels: lm_forward_fp16_kerB -> fused_softmax_ker1 -> allreduce
```
kim: kerA vs kerB are two variants chosen by our kernel picker based on pad pattern + quant flag. when they differ across ranks, compute times diverge by ~2-4ms.
robert: that explains residual tails. maybe prefer deterministic kernel selection during multi-rank runs (force same kernel family) or add a small local delay to equalize.
maya: could we influence picker by adding a per-request feature: prefer_kernel_family=X in metadata? easier than forcing across whole model.
kim: good idea. also tried a lightweight telemetry change: instrumented microtimers around kv-cache warmup + allreduce entry/exit. output example (per-request):
```
WAVE_PHASE: 0.12  kv_warmup_start: 1582345 kv_warmup_end: 1582350 compute_end: 1582356 allreduce_start: 1582357 allreduce_end: 1582359
```
kim: computed phase skew as (allreduce_start - kv_warmup_end). distribution tightened from sigma=3.1ms -> 0.9ms with alignment.
sasha: sweet. what about cost? any extra idle due to forced alignment?
kim: worst-case added delay per-microbatch ~0.6ms when shifting forward, but net token cost improves due to fewer allreduce stalls. we measured slightly higher GPU utilization too.
robert: for a robust rollout, we should: 1) emit wavefront_phase metric to telemetry backend, 2) add an override to kernel picker to prefer family consensus, 3) run A/B on a small dedicated Dedicated pool.
maya: agree. also run stress with mixed seq lengths — long seqs will toggle kernel selection more. capture nsight+samples for both.
kim: plan to land 'REDWOOD_TRACE_WAVEFRONT=1' (runtime env) that flips alignment and extra timers; add metric name: redwood.wavefront.phase_ms and redwood.wavefront.kerneldiff_count.
robert: minor: ensure deploy-bot can annotate experiment with feature flag and rollout percentage.
deploy-bot: scheduled rollout: eng-runtime/stage -> 10% traffic -> 2026-03-20T15:00Z. see runbook link: https://internal/rundocs/wavefront-rollout
sasha: for profiler captures, request these flags: 
```
nsys profile --output wavefront-${RANK} --trace=cuda,nvtx --sample=cpu --duration=20s
nvprof --print-gpu-trace --csv --log-file nvprof-${RANK}.csv
```
sasha: also add nvtx ranges around allreduce calls and KV cache ops so we can filter easily.
kim: already added NVTX markers in a local branch: PR incoming. will attach a short example capture and the distribution plots once done.
maya: one more thought — batching heuristic grain size: we should avoid microbatch sizes that create beat frequencies with ring-allreduce chunking (observed some rhythmic contention). try shifting microbatch size by +1 token and re-evaluate.
kim: noted. ok next steps: land telemetry + env flag, run 3 runs (baseline, aligned, aligned+kernel-consensus) across mixed seq lengths, collect nsight/nvprof and wavefront histograms, then evaluate throughput/p99/p50 and kernel-switch counts.
robert: sounds good. thanks kim.
kim: thanks team :rocket: will post short summary and bind artifacts to the ticket.
